// diagnostic E1266

Jet.InvalidImageKind

`` `<word>` isn't an image kind Jetpack builds ``.

What

`` `<word>` isn't an image kind Jetpack builds ``.

Why

Jetpack images are OCI containers, written `kind: .Oci`. A `jet image` run reports this image declaration error.

Fix

Write `kind: .Oci`.
